document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You  become  entangled  in  the  undergrowth  while  the  gray 
figure  speeds  nimbly  on  to  freedom.  When  he  reaches  his 
people, they may hide from your expedition. But they also may 
form a vengeful war party.

To press on and search them out, go to 85. To flee their territory, go 
to 231.
